tools.name: search_templates
tools.description: Search the Meme Studio catalog by name, keywords or what the meme is used for (intent), in Spanish or English. Best matches first, each with what it is used for.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Details of one template: names, what it is used for, tags, size, whether it is animated and its slots (the boxes where captions go). Each slot has fits_chars, about how many characters fit in it at a good size (0 is a small slot for a word or two): keep its caption under that or the text comes out s

tools.name: popular_templates
tools.description: Templates people choose most in Meme Studio: trending this week or most used overall.

tools.name: create_meme
tools.description: Create a meme on exactly one of: template (a catalog id), image (your own picture in base64 or a data: URL; JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF, up to 5 MB and 25 megapixels (16 for WebP, 8 for GIF, less for a large progressive JPEG), 100 px or more a side, at most 4:1; a GIF gives its first frame) or image_url

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "create_meme" is 2009 chars, far longer than this server's median (373). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
